_doc: Run-wide survivor tuning (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md sections 5, 6; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Everything here is tier C (ours / emulator-like) unless a note says otherwise; canonical WZ numbers are never copied here except where noted as a survivor choice of equipment.

exp_curve._formula: exp_to_next(L) = round(a + b*L + c*L^2): L1 15, L7 79, L29 687

player._start: Level 1 Beginner with 50 HP / 5 MP / 4 INT (the v83 new-character minimums) and Three Snails rank 1.
player._magic_attack: Total magic attack (weapon) per job. 200: the Wooden Wand 1372005 (Character.wz incMAD 23, reqLevel 8) a new Magician holds.
player._body: Touch hitbox relative to the feet (x, y, w, h), roughly the v83 character's body + head.

_mob_speed_factor: mob move speed px/s = (speed stat + 100) x this x stage speed (MobKind.SPEED_SCALE is the same 0.625; a different value here rescales every mob)
_pickup: EXP drops: pop speed and sideways spread (px/s), magnet start speed (px/s) and acceleration (px/s^2), live drops before new EXP merges into the nearest. They fall with Physics.img gravity/fallSpeed.
_spawn: SpawnDirector: margin outside the view, band of the first spawn ring, min distance to the player, samples per ring, recycle distance (px) and time (s).
